intro.text: The party arrives by the evening ferry. Rain. The harbour bell is silent, which the locals notice and the party will not, yet.

scenes.title: Strong start: The ferryman will not take their coin

blocks.text: The ferryman holds up a hand before you can pay. "Keep it. You'll need it for the priest." He will not say more, and poles away into the dark.
If pressed: he lost a son to the chapel. He is afraid, not rude.
Mira the fence is in the corner booth. She wants the party to notice her without approaching. She knows where the bell went.
• Rooms are 5 sp. The innkeeper overcharges strangers by double.
• A notice on the wall: "Lost: church bell. Reward from Father Orm."
• If anyone asks about the chapel, the room goes quiet.

scenes.title: Scene: Father Orm at the chapel steps

blocks.text: The chapel door is chained from the outside. The chain is new.
Orm admits the bell was stolen a week ago and the tides have been wrong since. He offers 50 gp and a blessing. He is lying about the blessing.
